subject: Asset handoff ops playbook — testcases, prompt packs, and usage guardrails
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire@brightretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Data Science Ops <datascienceops@brightretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: handing over eval samples + ask for MAP timeline

Hi Kimberly / Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, our DS team is ready to provision an initial evaluation bundle (test cases, prompt pack, sample records) so Redwood can run the quality/latency checks and complete the MAP acceptance criteria.

Attached: brightretail_eval_samples_v1.zip (zip, ~120MB) — contains 5k anonymized test prompts, 250 reference responses, and a short README.

Can you confirm:
- A target turnaround for Redwood to ingest these and provide a preliminary evaluation report (basic eval metrics + any model mismatch notes)?
- Any required access constraints on our side (IP allowlist, ephemeral credentials, encryption expectations)?

We need the MAP and handoff schedule for our procurement and security gates — ideally we have a timeline and list of required DocuSign items by next Tuesday (17 Nov).

Appreciate it — Claire

--
Claire Ng
Head of AI Partnerships | BrightRetail
claire@brightretail.com | +1 415 555 0147

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Claire Ng <claire@brightretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: handing over eval samples + ask for MAP timeline

Hi Claire —

Thanks for sending the bundle. Quick notes and proposed next steps (high level):

1) Ingestion & sandbox access (internal owner: marissa_cole)
   - We will ingest the zip into our ephemeral eval sandbox (isolated project) within 48h of sign-off.
   - Access: we request an IP allowlist CIDR and a short-lived service account credential for the sandbox. No permanent exports.

2) Evaluation cadence (owner: vivek_kulkarni)
   - Day 0–2: Dry-run ingestion + smoke test; report any schema mismatches.
   - Day 3–5: Run automated evals (quality, hallucination rate, latency profiles at 1- and 5-token warmup).
   - Day 6: Preliminary evaluation report delivered to BrightRetail.

3) Usage guardrails (must be agreed before ingestion)
   - Samples are for Redwood internal evaluation only; no redistribution or use in model training beyond the MAP scope.
   - Data retention: sandbox will hold materials for 90 days post-ingestion, then auto-delete unless extended by written consent.
   - Access limited to named engineers on our side (marissa, vivek, two infra engineers).

4) Legal & procurement items
   - We'll send a short MAP checklist (attached) that captures the items we need to close (NDA/MPA, allowed uses, deletion confirmation).

5) Timeline proposal
   - Sign MAP checklist / DocuSign: by Tue 17 Nov
   - Ingestion window: Wed 18 Nov–Thu 19 Nov
   - Eval report: Mon 23 Nov

Attached: Redwood-MAP-checklist.xlsx, redwood-provisioning-playbook.pdf (ops notes).

If that aligns with your procurement and security windows we can route DocuSign + HubSpot updates today. Rishi — can you confirm we can offer an additional two weeks of POC credits if BrightRetail needs more time to validate?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Claire Ng <claire@brightretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Data Science Ops <datascienceops@brightretail.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightretail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: handing over eval samples + ask for MAP timeline

Kimberly —

This looks good, thanks. A couple of security asks from our side before ingestion:

- Our security team wants assurance that sample IDs are irreversibly hashed before any internal export and that all system logs related to the eval run are retained for 30 days for audit.
- Deletion after 90 days is acceptable but we need an attestation document (short statement) confirming deletion if that is performed.
- We also need to confirm that no model training/weight updates will occur on production models using these samples — only inference evaluation on sandboxed instances.

Attached: BR_Security_RQ.docx (internal requirements). Can you confirm these points are OK? Also please send the DocuSign link for the MAP checklist when ready — procurement wants to start routing.

Thanks,
Claire

--
Claire Ng
Head of AI Partnerships | BrightRetail

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Claire Ng <claire@brightretail.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: handing over eval samples + ask for MAP timeline

Claire — quick note from the commercial side: we can confirm the POC credit extension — adding two additional weeks of test credits tied to deal BR-4582-MAP. I'll update the HubSpot deal and queue the MAP checklist DocuSign.

Two asks:
- Please confirm the single point of contact for procurement (name + email) so we route the DocuSign appropriately.
- If BrightRetail needs the 90-day retention extended, we can do that via a simple amendment.

I'll be available to jump on a 20-min sync if you want to align procurement + security later this week.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Claire Ng <claire@brightretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: handing over eval samples + ask for MAP timeline

Claire —

Following up with the finalized ops playbook and explicit guardrails so procurement/security have a single source of truth. Summary / actions: 

- DocuSign: MAP checklist (HubSpot deal BR-4582-MAP) — https://www.docusign.com/en/link/BR-4582-mpa-nda (I routed it this morning).
- Ingestion window: Nov 18–19 (completed). Dry-run passed on Nov 18; no schema issues.
- Eval report delivery: Nov 23 (attached: redwood-provisioning-playbook.pdf contains the report appendix).

Explicit usage guardrails (agreed):
- Purpose: Redwood will run inference-only evaluations on sandboxed instances. No training, finetuning, or persistence of raw samples beyond the sandbox retention window.
- Retention: 90 days from ingestion (auto-delete). Redwood will produce a signed deletion attestation and a purge audit log within 7 days of deletion.
- Hashing/exports: any exported sample IDs will be one-way hashed; exports contain only hashed identifiers and aggregate metrics.
- Access: limited to marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni, and two named infra engineers (list attached in HubSpot).
- Redistribution: no sharing outside Redwood engineering and product teams involved in the MAP.

Attachments placed in shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_EXAMPLE-mpa-onboarding
DocuSign and HubSpot updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BR-4582

Next steps (for BrightRetail):
- Procurement SPOC for DocuSign routing — please reply with name/email.
- Security: Tom, once you confirm acceptance in writing of hashing + retention, we will begin the signed deletion attestation cadence (post-90 day).

If that matches your expectations I'll close the MAP onboarding task and mark the trial in HubSpot as "Sandbox active — eval running".

Thanks all —
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
